This is a declared tactile adaptation of the source construction. This is a declared tactile adaptation of the source construction. The tips retain their intentional taper. Black outlines and dots do not intrinsically encode country or colour; use the accessible external identity/colour key. This is a teaching layout, not a certified statutory or textile drawing.
